findings.title: throwing subcommand spawn escapes runCheckpoint
findings.action: Treat a spawn that throws as that step's failed read.
findings.disposition_rationale: runCheckpoint's spawn wrapper now turns a throw into status null, so it lands as the step's named fault and fail-closed on an acting run (test 'spawn throws'). The rethrow of a non-parse config error stays deliberate: readGovernanceConfig's legacy-name refusal is meant to exit loud, and the caller treats that exit as fail-closed.
